title: How To Make Soft Layered Roti | Paratha #recipe

sources.provider: YouTube · Maple Kitchen · Creative Commons Attribution license (reuse allowed) · https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FX3KAGdnKQk

events.description: The host introduces making roti or paratha and notes that some countries call it roti while others call it paratha.
events.title: Introduction to Roti/Paratha making

events.description: The host lists the ingredients needed: all purpose flour, salt, sugar, lukewarm water, and oil.
events.title: Listing required ingredients

events.description: The host measures flour, sugar, and salt, then mixes them together nicely.
events.title: Mixing dry ingredients

events.description: The host adds lukewarm water gradually to the dry mixture, using just as much as needed.
events.title: Adding water to dough

events.description: The host kneads the dough on the countertop, working it until it comes together.
events.title: Kneading the dough

events.description: The host indicates the dough is nearly done and prepares to add oil.
events.title: Preparing to add oil

events.description: The host adds a teaspoon of oil to the dough and incorporates it.
events.title: Adding oil to dough

events.description: The host states the dough is ready and begins using a pastry mat for further preparation.
events.title: Dough ready, using pastry mat

events.description: The cook sprinkles flour on a pastry mat and divides the dough into smaller balls.
events.title: Sprinkle flour and divide dough

events.description: Various dough portions are measured and displayed on screen with centimeter markings.
events.title: Measure dough pieces

events.description: The dough is rolled out into thin roti shapes on the mat.
events.title: Roll dough thinly

events.description: The cook brushes oil onto the rolled dough, mentions oil or butter, and adds a little more flour.
events.title: Brush oil and add flour

events.description: The dough is rolled up in a spiral, similar to a cinnamon roll, to create layers.
events.title: Roll dough like cinnamon roll

events.description: A little oil is added on top, the dough is covered, and left to rest for about thirty minutes.
events.title: Oil and rest dough

events.description: The dough rests for 30‑35 minutes before the cook proceeds to make the rotis.
events.title: Rest dough then prepare

events.description: The cook shapes the rested dough into rotis and rolls them as thin as possible.
events.title: Make and roll rotis

events.description: The video shows on-screen text indicating various dough sizes in centimeters while the narrator says 'Ensure'.
events.title: Measure dough dimensions

events.description: The narrator instructs to make sure the pan is hot before cooking, with on-screen text 'you start'.
events.title: Heat the pan

events.description: The narrator says to cook both sides and add oil, while a spatula is visible.
events.title: Cook roti with oil

events.description: The narrator declares the roti is ready, with on-screen text 'AUTION' possibly indicating completion.
events.title: Roti is ready

events.description: The narrator says the roti is soft and can be enjoyed with curry or as a wrap, while on-screen text shows 'with any curry'.
events.title: Serve the soft roti

events.description: The video ends with a thank-you screen prompting viewers to like, comment, and share.
events.title: End of video
